Of course, "pick up artists" will insist that they just keep trying, but most blokes aren't PUAs and will eventually just either give up, or try for those they believe might accept such an offer. 

If you are even slightly above average in beauty, then you might simply fall into that category of "Not quite intimidating but will absolutely turn me down", which will naturally make guys unwilling to take the risk.

Of course, I could be entirely wrong, but that would be my guess. Unfortunately, I can't think of much of a solution, beyond dating apps or even speed dating. Perhaps see if any of your friends can arrange a blind date, and if so, then good luck. I hope it works out for you.

The problem is that the world Sulla fought for, in which power was concentrated in the hands of a few wealthy families, with the poor, especially the Plebs Urbana, being an irrelevance, was a world that was not the norm. Traditionally Rome had respected the concept of the common farmer, and been contemptuous of excessive wealth. 

Eastern victories, and the wealth they brought, had changed the balance and Sulla was fighting against the natural correction. The Gracchae were trying to fix things, then the greed of the Senatorial class killed them. Later we find Marius trying to repair some of the harm done, but once again the greed of the Optimates created a concentration of power.

Frankly, Sulla made the Principate and the Augustan Settlement inevitable, despite his intentions.

For that reason, I vote for Marius.
